intro: Preview a version on the page, then choose it. Your choices are saved locally for the next editing pass; they do not change the website.
saved: Saved locally. The website is unchanged.
ready: Choose a section to begin. Previewing does not save a choice.
previewing: Previewing {option}. Choose it to save your decision.
saveFailed: Could not save. Your preview is still here; retry or export it before closing.
conflict: Choices changed in another tab. Reload to load those choices before saving.
offline: Local saving is unavailable. You can still compare and edit; export your work before closing.
storageUnavailable: Browser draft storage is unavailable. Save your choices to the local server or export them before closing.
editHelp: Changes appear in the page preview. Use “Choose this version” to save them. An empty eyebrow removes that small label.
editFootnote: Platform support facts and link destinations stay unchanged.
summaryHelp: Saved choices are available in .local/review-state.json. When you’re finished, return to the conversation and ask to apply them.
heading: Heading
exported: Exported saved choices and current previews.
failedLoad: The review data could not be loaded. Reload this page.
pageNote: Local copy review · Current page layout · Frozen screenshot
